title: Marooning vs Keelhauling
hook: Stealing from your crew got you marooned on a sandbar.

scenes.text: Golden Age pirates lived under strict written rules called the Ship's Articles, sworn on a Bible or an iron hatchet.

scenes.text: If a pirate stole from his fellow crewmates or cheated in dice, the punishment wasn't prison—it was marooning.

scenes.text: The guilty sailor was rowed to an uninhabited desert island and left with one pistol, one lead ball, a flask of water, and a pouch of gunpowder.
